input.value: walkway in front of policyholder's house
child slipped and fell on icy walkway during ice storm

input.rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) sustained a bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises (walkway) due to an icy condition, triggering premises liability coverage.

Pediatric injury (9-year-old with broken wrist) involving ongoing medical treatment and potential complications; broken bones in children are classified as serious injuries requiring prompt adjuster attention.

input.claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor slipped on ice on policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm and broke her wrist. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Pediatric injury with ongoing treatment; requires prompt investigation and coverage verification.
